GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (3 Feb 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1504)
APO 500
3 February 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Notification of Death.
The following War Criminals were executed at RABAUL, New Britain by the method and on the date stated after their names. They were executed in accordance with applicable law, by virtue of the order of Headquarters, Australian Military Forces, Melbourne, Victoria, Australia.
NAME DESIGNATION DATE METHOD
KAMINAKA, Tsunejiro S/Maj, assignment 16 Spec Water Duty Co. 6 Nov 46 Death by hanging
KOBAYASHI, Shotaro Sgt, assignment 26 Spec Construction Co. 1 Aug 46 Death by hanging
MATSUMURA, Tadashi S/Maj, assignment 16 Spec Water Duty Co. 19 Oct 46 Death by hanging
SATO, Hikoju Civ, assignment NANYO TAKUSHOKU Co, attached to Navy. 31 Aug 46 Death by hanging
YAMAMOTO, Hisashi Civ Off, assignment Naval Civil Administration. 6 Nov 46 Death by hanging
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
